tasks.instruction: Amounts of 500 or more pay a fee of the amount divided by 100; amounts below 500 pay a flat fee of 8. Fix the boundary.
Return the low byte of p0 with its two 4-bit halves swapped; every bit above the low byte must be zero.
tasks.note: Start leaks bits above the low byte through the right shift.

tasks.instruction: Write the element at position p1 plus one into the next position (position 3 wraps to 0); the rest of the array stays the same.
Scale p0 by 5 instead of 3, and keep reporting whether the scaled (wrapped 32-bit) value exceeds 100.
tasks.note: Wrong edit tests the unscaled input, which disagrees once the multiplication wraps.

tasks.instruction: Advance a three-state cycle: 0 goes to 1, 1 to 2 and 2 back to 0; any other value just increases by one (wrapping).
tasks.note: Wrong edit sends every value from 2 upward to 0.

tasks.instruction: Return true when the element at position p1 is strictly greater than both of its neighbours (the array is circular).
tasks.note: Start accepts a tie on the left neighbour.

tasks.instruction: The checksum must fold every one of the four elements exactly once, starting from 7.
tasks.note: Start skips the last element; count 5 revisits element 0.

tasks.instruction: Orders whose total (p0 times p1) is at least 200 get 20 taken off the total; return the final amount and whether the discount applied.
Shift every element one place toward the end (the last one is dropped) and put p1 in position 0.
Add a level: scores from 70 to 79 give 2. Scores of 90 or more still give 4, 80 to 89 give 3, and below 70 give 0.
tasks.note: Requires inserting a compare and a select.

tasks.instruction: Return true when p0 is a multiple of 8 and at least 16.
tasks.note: Two nodes are wrong: the mask and the bound.

tasks.instruction: f must return h(p0, 2) plus h(p0 + 1, 3), with wrapping arithmetic.
tasks.note: h is not symmetric in its arguments.

tasks.instruction: f should count the positions 1 to 3 whose element differs from the element just before it; the first element must not be compared with the last.
tasks.note: The helper compares cyclically; f must remove the wrap-around pair.

tasks.instruction: Element k of the result must be byte k of p0, counting from the least significant byte.
Return true exactly when the helper's state machine is in its final, sticky state after all four elements.
tasks.note: States: 0 wants 7, 1 wants 2, 2 wants 9, 3 is sticky.

tasks.instruction: One tick of a toggling counter: when the flag is set the count doubles, otherwise it grows by 3; the flag flips on every tick.
tasks.note: Start adds 1 and never flips the flag.
